title: The Alchemist's Laboratory
description: A blue-skinned humanoid alchemist in a green velvet robe stands at a wooden desk, carefully pouring golden liquid from a vial into a bowl. The scene is filled with lit candles, glowing jars of potions, an open spellbook titled STASIS, a red quill, scattered papers, and a large ornate mirror reflecting a distant scene, while a giant blue beetle hangs from purple drapery above.
prompt: A blue-skinned fantasy alchemist with purple lips wearing an ornate green velvet robe stands at a wooden desk inside a mystical laboratory. He is pouring glowing golden liquid from a glass vial into a white bowl. On the desk lies a large red book titled STASIS, an open spellbook with arcane symbols, a red quill, and scattered magical papers. Behind him are shelves filled with glowing potions in glass jars, dripping red candles, and purple curtains. A giant metallic blue beetle hangs from the ceiling. An ornate gold mirror reflects another mystical scene. Cinematic lighting, rich colors, detailed fantasy illustration.
